During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Marr]] formed a '''task force''', consisting of [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] with unofficial support from the Republic, to search [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] for [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] and the source of the [[Eternal Empire|mysterious force]] that had [[Eternal Empire raids|attacked]] Imperial and Republic [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />
